args.request: Fix the independently discovered MC3 VIF parser defect: CL>WL destination skip cycles must not silently become contiguous static geometry. Retain supported real corpus behavior and add meaningful corruption controls. This review is scoped to this correction, not completion of the whole dealership feature.
args.diff:
--- a/tools/mc3_pck.py
+++ b/tools/mc3_pck.py
@@ -72,7 +72,9 @@
     """Expand bounded VIF UNPACK arrays, including STCYCL and row deltas.
 
     Only the commands present in this geometry corpus are accepted. Each plane
-    retains its source command offset and destination VU address.
+    retains its source command offset, destination VU address and cycle state.
+    Values are UNPACK vectors, not a sparse VU memory image; destination skip
+    cycles are rejected by the contiguous geometry decoder below.
     """
     data = pck.data
     end = pck.bounds(start, size) + size
@@ -154,6 +156,12 @@
 
 
 def decode_batches(planes: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
+    # CL > WL advances the destination over unwritten VU addresses. Treating
+    # those vectors as contiguous would silently produce different geometry.
+    # No supported source draw uses this mode; retain raw scan state but reject
+    # it before interpreting either a batch header or any attribute array.
+    if any(plane["cl"] > plane["wl"] for plane in planes):
+        raise ValueError("unsupported VIF destination skip cycle")
     batches = []
     headers = [i for i, p in enumerate(planes) if p["components"] in {1, 4} and p["bits"] == 32]
     if not headers or headers[0] != 0:
--- a/tools/test_mc3_pck.py
+++ b/tools/test_mc3_pck.py
@@ -40,6 +40,26 @@
 
 
 class PacketTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_destination_skip_cycles_do_not_become_contiguous_geometry(self):
+        stream = packet()
+        # CL=2, WL=1 writes VU addresses start, start+2, start+4, ...
+        # It must not produce the contiguous square accepted by the old reader.
+        controls = {
+            "header_and_attributes": command(1, 0, 0x0102) + stream,
+            "attributes_only": stream[:36] + command(1, 0, 0x0102) + stream[36:],
+        }
+        for name, altered in controls.items():
+            with self.subTest(name=name):
+                planes = vif_planes(Pck(carrier(altered)), 128, len(altered))
+                self.assertTrue(any(plane["cl"] > plane["wl"] for plane in planes))
+                self.assertEqual(planes[-1]["count"], 4)
+                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "destination skip cycle"):
+                    decode_batches(planes)
+        # A state command without a following UNPACK does not affect geometry.
+        trailing_state = stream + command(1, 0, 0x0102)
+        batch = decode_batches(vif_planes(Pck(carrier(trailing_state)), 128, len(trailing_state)))[0]
+        self.assertEqual(batch["positions"], [(0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0), (1, 1, 0)])
+
     def test_shared_group_recovers_exact_missing_body(self):
         code = "vp_belair_57"
         main = read_vehicle(next((ROOT / "midnight-club-3-remix/cars" / code).rglob(code + ".pck")))
claims: The new regression rejects skipped header and skipped attribute UNPACKs for the intended destination skip cycle reason, preserves trailing unused state, and all ten parser tests plus lint pass.

The exact audited accepted corpus contains zero CL>WL UNPACKs, and before/after source records, packet counts, UNPACK cycle counts and page rejection lists are identical: 94 main, 95 shared occurrences, 4135 standalone, 183 accepted rim pages and 98 tire pages. Ten unsupported rim pages are explicitly excluded.
The correction rejects unsupported skip geometry before reading headers/attributes; it preserves raw scan state and does not claim sparse VU emulation or completion of dealership integration.
